scope: Full current unchanged lease test file; replacement constraint verification, not a changed-test inventory entry
assessment: Independent client cannot register without matching token
Expired producer cannot register; recovery creates separate retry and preserves interrupted original
Renewal rotates token and rejects stale completion; prior lease records retained
Active lease cannot be taken over; invalid duration creates no attempt record
Concurrent recovery yields exactly one replacement
Lease expiry is rechecked before artifact commit and no artifact record is published
Heartbeat renews within scoped guard; CLI stale token rejected and latest token succeeds
limitations: Thread concurrency and real local CLI are exercised; this file does not prove process-crash or cross-filesystem recovery
Heartbeat assertion waits up to two seconds; production timing under resource pressure requires separate acceptance
